Class Painter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.types.character.Character
it.polimi.ingsw.model.entities.card.types.character.Painter
public class Painter extends Character
A character card representing a painter villager.

Painters contribute to two end-game bonuses: every pair of painters in the village scores 10 prestige points, and when the paint bonus is active (via Player.activatePaintBonus()), each painter grants one extra food when the player enters a queue tile.
